svg.title: Choose the optical system around the route

g.text: Choose the optical system around the route
Wider wavelength spacing; often a simpler starting point.
Confirm supported channels, optics, fibre loss and growth needs.
Denser channels and options for amplified optical transport.
Confirm line-system spectrum, filtering, OSNR and channel width.
Conventional 400ZR/ZR+ needs at least 75 GHz planning.
A 50 GHz fixed-grid ROADM path is not automatically compatible.
